# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

We actively support and provide security updates for:

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.x     | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take the security of Seed-VC iPad App seriously. If you believe you have found a security vulnerability, please report it to us as described below.

**Please do NOT report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.**

### How to Report a Vulnerability

1. **Email**: Send details to our security team at [security@example.com](mailto:security@example.com)
2. **Details**: Include the following information in your report:
   - Type of vulnerability
   - Steps to reproduce
   - Potential impact
   - Suggested fix (if applicable)

### Response Time

- Initial response within 48 hours
- Regular updates every 7 days
- Fix deployed within 14 days for critical vulnerabilities

### What to Expect

Once you submit your report, we will:
- Confirm receipt of your report
- Keep you informed of the progress
- Work with you to verify the issue
- Credit you in our security acknowledgments (if you wish)

## Security Best Practices

When using Seed-VC iPad App:

1. **Keep Updated**: Always use the latest version
2. **Verify Sources**: Download only from official sources
3. **Privacy**: Don't share sensitive audio files
4. **Permissions**: Review app permissions carefully

### Local Processing

Seed-VC processes all audio data locally on your device. No audio data is transmitted to external servers, ensuring your privacy and data security.

## Security Updates

Security updates will be released as soon as possible after a vulnerability is confirmed. We will:
- Notify users via GitHub Release notes
- Update the CHANGELOG with security information
- Provide rollback instructions if necessary

Thank you for helping keep Seed-VC iPad App secure! 🔒
